name: Social media coordinator / community manager (category)
summary: Planning, posting and monitoring social media content for an organization, as an employee or freelancer. Job Bank files it under professional occupations in advertising, marketing and public relations (NOC 11202).
whatYouDo: You plan and schedule posts, write captions, prepare simple graphics or short clips, answer comments and messages, and report on engagement. Employees usually sit in a marketing or communications team. Freelancers manage accounts for several small businesses or creators.
appeal: Job Bank national wages for social media coordinators: $20.50 low, $35.58 median, $57.44 high per hour (updated November 2025)
Job Bank's Alberta page says 21% of this occupational group is self-employed, against 15% across all occupations, so freelance work is common
Yukon outlook is rated Good for 2025–2027, partly because businesses increasingly rely on social media and digital platforms (Job Bank)
Much of the work can be done remotely and in writing
Related titles to search include marketing coordinator, media coordinator and digital marketing consultant (Job Bank)
watchOuts: Job Bank says the occupation usually requires a university degree. Without one, entry generally relies on a portfolio and freelance or volunteer results
No national outlook was found. Alberta and Nova Scotia are rated only Moderate for 2025–2027 (Job Bank)
Job Bank says workers in this group usually work more than 40 hours per week

Fake 'social media' jobs are a major scam. The Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre warns of 'task' offers to like, boost or review products, apps or videos that pay small amounts and then demand deposits. Reported losses were $49M in 2024 and $46.5M in the first nine months of 2025
A legitimate social media job never asks you to pay, buy crypto or 'unlock' tasks
Freelance work has no guaranteed hours or benefits

credentials: University degree usually required for employee roles (Job Bank)

training.notes: No specific training requirement found beyond the university degree Job Bank says employee roles usually expect.

compensation.notes: Job Bank wages for 'Social Media Coordinator' (NOC 11202), Canada, updated 19 Nov 2025: low $20.50, median $35.58, high $57.44 per hour. Ontario median about $37.02. These are employee wages; Job Bank says 89.1% of workers in the occupation get at least one non-wage benefit. Freelance rates were not researched.

reliability.notes: Employee roles are ordinary salaried jobs. Freelance volume depends on building a client base. Outlook varies by province: Good in Yukon, Moderate in Alberta and Nova Scotia (2025–2027).

applicationSteps: Build a small portfolio: sample posts, a content calendar and engagement results (for example for a club, charity or small business)
Search Job Bank and other boards for social media coordinator, marketing coordinator, media coordinator and digital marketing consultant
For freelance work, approach local small businesses directly or use general freelance platforms
Never pay to start a 'social media task' job. Report suspected scams to the Canadian Anti-Fraud Centre
fitsIf: You write well, enjoy online communities and simple visuals, and can show results through a portfolio.
notFitIf: You want work with no audience or client contact, or need a steady paycheque soon without a degree or portfolio.
